methods.label: Pythagorean theorem
methods.explanation: The third side is the hypotenuse. By the Pythagorean theorem, its length is \(\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=\sqrt{25}=5\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the elementary Pythagorean theorem and the positive square root of 25.
